description: This file defines the interface IController within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. It includes method declarations for controlling system state and configurations, such as Persist, Delete, Reboot, Environment, Configuration, and Clone. The interface is marked as deprecated and extends from Core::IUnknown.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for controlling system functions, configuration management, and environment variables within the WPEFramework plugin host context. It includes methods for persistence, deletion, rebooting, environment retrieval, configuration management, and cloning of call signs.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Delete a resource specified by the path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieve the environment variable associated with the given index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieve the configuration associated with the specified callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Set the configuration for the specified callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Create a clone of a callsign based on another callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
